keyVerseDR: "...blessed are they that have not seen and have believed." (Jn 20:29)

level1.title: Thomas Believes
level1.story: Jesus came to His friends and said, "Peace be with you!" Thomas was not there and did not believe. Then Jesus showed him His hands. Thomas said, "My Lord and my God!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do you know Jesus loves you?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I trust in You. Amen.

activity.title: What did they say?
activity.intro: Write what Jesus and Thomas said.

level2.title: Peace Be With You
level2.story: On Easter evening, the disciples were behind locked doors, and Jesus stood among them saying, "Peace be with you." He breathed on them and gave them power to forgive sins. Thomas was not there and said, "Unless I see the marks in His hands, I will not believe." A week later, Jesus came again and told Thomas to touch His wounds. Thomas said, "My Lord and my God!" Jesus said, "Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed."
level2.keyLine: Blessed are they that have not seen and have believed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did Jesus help Thomas believe?
How does Jesus give us mercy today?
level2.prayer: Jesus, I trust in You. Amen.

activity.title: God forgives
activity.intro: Jesus gave the Apostles power to forgive sins. Write a note to someone you want to make peace with.
